claim_boundary: This preregistration defines an exact CQ3 x CQ8 native-kernel test motivated by T-MAC prior art. A pass would establish only a storage-neutral, integer-exact primitive and authorize all-MLP graph integration. It cannot establish whole-model quality, throughput, energy, novelty, 100 tokens per second, or a scientific breakthrough.
comparators: accepted storage-neutral CQ3_0x8 AVX2 kernel from v15

decision_rules.pass: All exactness, storage, stability, and shape gates pass; geometric-mean candidate speedup is at least 1.15x over x8 and 1.45x over ordinary, with every shape at least 1.10x over x8.
decision_rules.reject: Any exactness or storage gate fails, any shape is below 1.10x x8, geometric-mean x8 speedup is below 1.15x, or paired MAD exceeds 0.03. Stop before graph integration.
decision_rules.retain_diagnostic_only: A numerically exact result below the speed gate may be retained as negative evidence but cannot be integrated or tuned post hoc.

hypothesis: On AMD Milan AVX2, a storage-neutral 32-output-row layout using activation-built signed-INT16 group-of-four subset tables can replace repeated CQ3 unpack and multiply-add work while keeping all row accumulators register-resident. If the lookup schedule is material, it will beat the accepted x8 kernel on both Qwen3.8 MLP shapes without changing a single trained code, CQ8 activation, group scale, or integer group dot.

implementation_contract.activation_lut: For each CQ8 group-128 activation, build 32 tables of all 16 signed INT16 subset sums; 1024 temporary bytes per group.
implementation_contract.accumulator: Keep 32 output-row INT16 group accumulators and FP32 cross-group accumulators in AVX2 registers; no output scratch read-modify-write loop.
implementation_contract.exact_identity: For digit d=code+1=b0+2*b1, compute L(b0)+2*L(b1)-sum(q8). This must equal sum(code*q8) as INT32 for every row and group.
implementation_contract.offline_weight_layout: One byte per four weights: low-nibble bit0 mask and high-nibble bit1 mask, tiled over 32 output rows.

literature_boundary.difference_under_test: The registered candidate preserves Clark CQ3 group-128 scales and CQ8 integer algebra exactly through signed-INT16 subset tables; it does not use T-MAC's quantized INT8 activation LUT algebra or claim a new lookup-table principle.

primary_prior_art.name: T-MAC: CPU Renaissance via Table Lookup for Low-Bit LLM Deployment on Edge

next_step_if_passed: Integrate the unchanged v44 trained CQ3 codes across all 192 MLP tensors, then run exact graph parity and whole-model decode gates. Do not infer model speed from the primitive.
stop_rules: Do not tune quartet width, output tile, lookup precision, or thresholds after observing v58 timing.
Do not run model integration unless the frozen native gates pass.
Do not overlap the benchmark with v44, v45, evaluation, or another performance process.
Do not call the method novel or a breakthrough from a primitive result.
